title: The X-panded Universe
notes: Standalone single, his third of 2026 (after 'The Old Law' in Jan., 'The Payoff' in May). No album announced. Rare solo tour Dec. 9-19 with Damien Jurado, ending with two Carmel-by-the-Sea shows Dec. 18-19. Label not stated in results.

title: Gentling the Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall
label: SUCK
notes: Debut release on Rose's own SUCK imprint. Produced by John Congleton, 11 tracks. Earlier singles 'Chow Mein' and 'Yip Yip Now'. 'Hello Again, Jim' goes after toxic music-industry men; video features Jimmi Simpson. Preview link is the official live video. Single date comes from a Sept. 15 tecoapple.com post. Seed note confirmed.

title: Cartoons
label: AMK / Kartel Music Group
notes: Third LP, 10 songs, a gentler sound with piano, fiddle and field recordings. Earlier single 'Love Song (A Good Kind of Weapon)'. Red vinyl LP and CD. Single date from thoughtswordsaction.com, Sept. 7. Seed note confirmed.

title: Voyager (7-inch)
notes: Digital single came out June 24. The limited 7-inch, sold only through the PJH store, ships Dec. 4. Recorded with an orchestra at Miraval. It's from a forthcoming album whose title and date haven't been announced. Included only for the 7-inch date.

title: Horsepower
notes: Forthcoming triple album, played in full at the Ryman in Nashville on Aug. 22, with guests Gillian Welch, Lucinda Williams and Iris DeMent. Recorded in May at Sound Emporium; twangy. No release date or label announced yet.
